# Upstreamthing

Upstreamthing is a synthetic project used as a rename engine test fixture.

## Overview

The upstreamthing-agent provides upstreamthing capabilities through
the `UpstreamthingCli` interface.

Set `UPSTREAMTHING_HOME` to override the default data directory.

## Usage

```python
from upstreamthing_cli import x
client = x()
```
